problems: Interactive demos are never captured. The page has 14 buttons, 5 range sliders and 4 checkboxes, but every candidate scores 4 (controls +2, low text +2) against a threshold of 5. The +3 media bonus never fires: the demos are HTML/CSS boxes, not svg or canvas. Demos therefore export as dead text — the Channels demo collapses to a bare <ul>.
Widget capture cannot be exercised by this fixture: detection needs layout (getBoundingClientRect), so it is a live-only check. This case pins what extraction does when no screenshots are provided.
